title: Australian PM says COP31 deal failure sign of ‘difficult geopolitical times’
summary: SYDNEY, Australia — Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese attributed on Monday the failure of COP31 climate talks to “difficult geopolitical times” after a contentious deal collapsed…

blocks.text: SYDNEY, Australia — Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese attributed on Monday the failure of COP31 climate talks to “difficult geopolitical times” after a contentious deal collapsed over fossil fuels and the summit in Turkey stretched into record overtime. “That is the reality,” the leader of Australia, which co-hosted the talks, told journalists in Canberra./dp READ: Climate
